results.description: Revenue, net income and total assets per individual company-year: pivot the long facts every time versus read the precomputed mart.
results.sql: SELECT nit, fiscal_year, max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE line = 'revenue') AS revenue, max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE line = 'net_income') AS net_income, max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE line = 'total_assets') AS total_assets FROM stg_niif_facts WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND statement_scope = 'individual' GROUP BY nit, fiscal_year

results.description: Revenue, net income and total assets per individual company-year: pivot the long facts every time versus read the precomputed mart.
results.sql: SELECT nit, fiscal_year, revenue, net_income, total_assets FROM company_year WHERE statement_scope = 'individual'

results.description: Same 581620 raw income-statement rows of FY2024 aggregated from the stored CSV (90 MB) and from a ZSTD Parquet copy (7 MB).

results.description: Sum of the 22 statement-line columns of the published company_year.parquet: all rows, a year filter (the file is sorted by nit, so row-group statistics cannot prune it) and a single-company filter that prunes row groups on the sorted nit column.
results.sql: SELECT sum(revenue), sum(cost_of_sales), sum(gross_profit), sum(admin_expenses), sum(selling_expenses), sum(operating_income), sum(finance_income), sum(finance_costs), sum(profit_before_tax), sum(income_tax), sum(net_income), sum(total_assets), sum(current_assets), sum(cash), sum(receivables), sum(inventories), sum(ppe), sum(total_liabilities), sum(current_liabilities), sum(noncurrent_liabilities), sum(total_equity), sum(operating_cash_flow) FROM read_parquet('web/public/data/marts/company_year.parquet')

results.description: Group-by with a median over all staged NIIF facts, run with one DuckDB thread and with every logical core.
results.sql: SELECT fiscal_year, statement_scope, line, count(*) AS facts, sum(value_cop) AS total, quantile_cont(value_cop, 0.5) AS median FROM stg_niif_facts GROUP BY ALL
